sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker used 'use super::*;' in layout.rs to access EditorUI private fields, and placed the build method in a separate impl block. This is a valid Rust pattern for submodule access to parent private fields. However, the convention for this project's splits (scene, application) uses different approaches — the scene split used standalone functions, while this split used impl blocks in submodules. Both are valid but inconsistent.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: editor_ui/layout.rs:18 uses 'use super::*;' and defines 'impl EditorUI { pub fn build(...) }'. Compare to scene/spawning.rs which uses standalone functions. The application split also uses impl blocks in submodules (application/events.rs, frame_loop.rs, etc.), so this split actually follows the application split pattern.
